id-20261023-news-1.title: Employment Bill Heading to the DPR Plenary Meeting: How to Read the Ratification Process and Articles Workers Should Watch

segments.src: Kabar bahwa pemerintah disebut telah menyetujui pembawaan Rancangan Undang-Undang (RUU) Ketenagakerjaan ke rapat paripurna DPR menarik perhatian banyak pekerja.
segments.tr: News that the government has reportedly agreed to bring the Employment Bill (RUU Ketenagakerjaan) to the DPR plenary meeting has caught the attention of many workers.

segments.src: Wajar, sebab undang-undang ini menyentuh urusan sehari-hari: besaran upah, kepastian kerja, hingga hak saat hubungan kerja berakhir.
segments.tr: Understandably so, as this law touches on everyday matters: wage amounts, job security, and rights when an employment relationship ends.

segments.src: Namun, kabar semacam ini mudah disalahartikan.
segments.tr: However, news like this is easily misinterpreted.

segments.src: Persetujuan untuk dibawa ke paripurna belum sama dengan undang-undang yang sudah berlaku.
segments.tr: Approval to bring a bill to a plenary meeting is not the same as a law already being in effect.

segments.src: Artikel ini membantu Anda memahami tahapannya dan bagian-bagian yang biasanya paling banyak dibahas.
segments.tr: This article helps you understand the stages and the sections most commonly discussed.

segments.src: > Catatan: Isi artikel bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat hukum. Rincian rancangan dapat berubah selama pembahasan, jadi selalu rujuk dokumen resmi terbaru.
segments.tr: > Note: The contents of this article are for general information and not legal advice. The details of the bill may change during discussions, so always refer to the latest official documents.

segments.src: ## Mengapa RUU Ini Penting
segments.tr: ## Why This Bill Matters

segments.src: Pembahasan RUU Ketenagakerjaan tidak lepas dari dinamika hukum perburuhan beberapa tahun terakhir, termasuk perubahan aturan lewat Undang-Undang Cipta Kerja dan putusan Mahkamah Konstitusi (MK) yang meminta pembentuk undang-undang menyusun regulasi ketenagakerjaan yang baru dalam jangka waktu tertentu.
segments.tr: The discussion of the Employment Bill cannot be separated from the dynamics of labor law in recent years, including regulatory changes through the Job Creation Law and the Constitutional Court (MK) ruling that asked lawmakers to draft new labor regulations within a certain timeframe.

segments.src: Karena itu, banyak pihak, mulai dari serikat pekerja, asosiasi pengusaha, akademisi, hingga pekerja individu, memperhatikan isi dan arah rancangan ini.
segments.tr: Therefore, many parties—ranging from labor unions, employer associations, academics, to individual workers—are paying attention to the content and direction of this bill.

segments.src: ## Tahapan Pengesahan Undang-Undang di DPR
segments.tr: ## Stages of Law Ratification in the DPR

segments.src: Secara garis besar, jalur sebuah RUU di DPR berjalan sebagai berikut.
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, the path of a bill in the DPR runs as follows.

segments.src: 1. **Perencanaan.** RUU masuk daftar Program Legislasi Nasional (Prolegnas), baik daftar jangka menengah maupun prioritas tahunan.
segments.tr: 1. **Planning.** The bill enters the National Legislation Program (Prolegnas) list, either the medium-term list or the annual priority.

segments.src: 2. **Penyusunan dan pengajuan.** Rancangan disusun oleh DPR, pemerintah, atau DPD sesuai bidangnya, lalu disertai naskah akademik.
segments.tr: 2. **Drafting and submission.** The bill is drafted by the DPR, the government, or the DPD according to their respective fields, accompanied by an academic text.

segments.src: 3. **Pembicaraan tingkat I.** Pembahasan di komisi, Badan Legislasi, atau panitia khusus bersama pemerintah. Di sini daftar inventarisasi masalah (DIM) dibahas, pasal demi pasal. Rapat dengar pendapat umum dengan serikat pekerja, pengusaha, dan pakar juga biasanya digelar.
segments.tr: 3. **Level I discussions.** Discussions take place in commissions, the Legislative Body, or special committees together with the government. Here, the list of problem inventories (DIM) is discussed, article by article. Public hearings with labor unions, employers, and experts are also usually held.

segments.src: 4. **Pengambilan keputusan tingkat I.** Fraksi-fraksi menyampaikan pandangan akhir, dan pemerintah menyatakan sikap. Inilah tahap yang sering diberitakan sebagai "disetujui dibawa ke paripurna".
segments.tr: 4. **Level I decision-making.** Factions convey their final views, and the government states its stance. This is the stage frequently reported as "agreed to be brought to the plenary meeting".

segments.src: 5. **Pembicaraan tingkat II di rapat paripurna.** Seluruh anggota DPR mengambil keputusan, umumnya melalui laporan hasil pembahasan, pandangan fraksi, dan persetujuan.
segments.tr: 5. **Level II discussions in the plenary meeting.** All DPR members make a decision, generally through reports on the discussion results, faction views, and approval.

segments.src: 6. **Pengesahan oleh Presiden.** Setelah disetujui bersama, RUU dikirim kepada Presiden untuk ditandatangani dan diundangkan. Menurut ketentuan pembentukan peraturan perundang-undangan, rancangan yang telah disetujui bersama tetap sah menjadi undang-undang jika tidak ditandatangani Presiden dalam waktu 30 hari.
segments.tr: 6. **Ratification by the President.** Once jointly approved, the bill is sent to the President to be signed and enacted. According to the provisions on the formation of laws and regulations, a jointly approved bill remains valid as law if not signed by the President within 30 days.

segments.src: Dengan kata lain, kabar tentang paripurna menandakan pembahasan sudah memasuki tahap akhir di DPR, tetapi masih ada proses lanjutan sebelum aturan itu berlaku.
segments.tr: In other words, news about the plenary meeting indicates that discussions have entered the final stage in the DPR, but there are still subsequent processes before the regulation takes effect.

segments.src: ## Isu yang Biasanya Diperdebatkan
segments.tr: ## Issues Commonly Debated

segments.src: Berikut topik yang lazim menjadi sorotan dalam pembahasan regulasi ketenagakerjaan.
segments.tr: Here are topics that typically become the spotlight in labor regulation discussions.

segments.src: Periksa teks rancangan terbaru untuk mengetahui bagaimana masing-masing diatur.
segments.tr: Check the latest draft text to see how each is regulated.

segments.src: ### 1. Upah
segments.tr: ### 1. Wages

segments.src: - Cara penetapan upah minimum (rumus, peran dewan pengupahan, dan indikator yang dipakai).
segments.tr: - How minimum wages are determined (formulas, the role of the wage council, and indicators used).

segments.src: - Ada tidaknya upah minimum sektoral.
segments.tr: - The presence or absence of sectoral minimum wages.

segments.src: - Struktur dan skala upah, serta kepastian kenaikan berkala.
segments.tr: - Wage structures and scales, as well as certainty of periodic increases.

segments.src: - Perlindungan terhadap keterlambatan atau pemotongan upah.
segments.tr: - Protection against wage delays or deductions.

segments.src: ### 2. Pesangon dan Pemutusan Hubungan Kerja (PHK)
segments.tr: ### 2. Severance Pay and Termination of Employment (PHK)

segments.src: - Komponen pesangon, uang penghargaan masa kerja, dan uang penggantian hak.
segments.tr: - Components of severance pay, service appreciation pay, and rights compensation pay.

segments.src: - Alasan PHK yang diperbolehkan serta prosedur yang wajib ditempuh.
segments.tr: - Permitted reasons for termination and mandatory procedures to be followed.

segments.src: - Kewajiban perundingan sebelum PHK dan mekanisme penyelesaian perselisihan.
segments.tr: - Obligations for negotiation prior to termination and dispute resolution mechanisms.

segments.src: - Hak pekerja selama proses sengketa berlangsung.
segments.tr: - Workers' rights while the dispute process is ongoing.

segments.src: ### 3. Alih Daya (Outsourcing)
segments.tr: ### 3. Outsourcing

segments.src: - Jenis pekerjaan yang boleh dialihdayakan, apakah dibatasi atau diserahkan pada pengaturan turunan.
segments.tr: - Types of work permitted to be outsourced, whether restricted or left to derivative regulations.

segments.src: - Perlindungan pekerja ketika perusahaan penyedia berganti, termasuk kesinambungan masa kerja dan hak.
segments.tr: - Worker protection when the provider company changes, including the continuity of service tenure and rights.

segments.src: - Tanggung jawab perusahaan pemberi kerja dan penyedia jasa.
segments.tr: - Responsibilities of the hiring company and the service provider.

segments.src: ### 4. Perjanjian Kerja Waktu Tertentu (PKWT)
segments.tr: ### 4. Specified-Time Work Agreements (PKWT)

segments.src: - Batas durasi dan jumlah perpanjangan kontrak.
segments.tr: - Duration limits and the number of contract extensions.

segments.src: - Ketentuan kompensasi di akhir kontrak.
segments.tr: - Compensation provisions at the end of the contract.

segments.src: - Kapan kontrak berubah menjadi hubungan kerja tetap.
segments.tr: - When a contract turns into a permanent employment relationship.

segments.src: ### 5. Isu Lain
segments.tr: ### 5. Other Issues

segments.src: - Jam kerja, lembur, dan waktu istirahat.
segments.tr: - Working hours, overtime, and rest time.

segments.src: - Perlindungan pekerja perempuan, penyandang disabilitas, serta pekerja platform digital dan pekerja lepas.
segments.tr: - Protection of female workers, workers with disabilities, as well as digital platform workers and freelancers.

segments.src: - Kebebasan berserikat dan perundingan bersama.
segments.tr: - Freedom of association and collective bargaining.

segments.src: - Jaminan sosial ketenagakerjaan.
segments.tr: - Employment social security.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Pasal dengan Cermat
segments.tr: ## How to Read Articles Carefully

segments.src: - **Cari pasal rujukan.** Banyak pasal yang berbunyi "diatur dengan peraturan pemerintah". Artinya detail penting, seperti rumus atau batas angka, baru ditentukan kemudian. Catat pasal mana saja yang menyerahkan rincian ke aturan turunan.
segments.tr: - **Look for reference articles.** Many articles state "to be regulated by government regulation". This means important details, such as formulas or numeric limits, are only determined later. Note which articles defer details to derivative rules.

segments.src: - **Bandingkan dengan aturan yang berlaku.** Letakkan teks rancangan berdampingan dengan ketentuan saat ini untuk melihat apa yang bertambah, berkurang, atau berubah rumusannya.
segments.tr: - **Compare with current rules.** Place the draft text side-by-side with current provisions to see what has been added, reduced, or changed in formulation.

segments.src: - **Perhatikan kata kunci.** Kata seperti "dapat", "wajib", "paling lama", dan "paling sedikit" membawa akibat hukum yang berbeda.
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to keywords.** Words like "may", "must", "at the latest", and "at least" carry different legal consequences.

segments.src: - **Cek ketentuan peralihan.** Bagian ini menentukan apakah kontrak atau hubungan kerja yang sudah berjalan ikut terpengaruh.
segments.tr: - **Check transitional provisions.** This section determines whether ongoing contracts or employment relationships are affected.

segments.src: - **Waspadai klaim yang beredar di media sosial.** Potongan pasal atau tangkapan layar bisa berasal dari draf lama. Pastikan Anda membaca versi yang bertanggal terbaru.
segments.tr: - **Beware of claims circulating on social media.** Excerpts of articles or screenshots may come from old drafts. Make sure you read the latest dated version.

segments.src: ## Cara Pekerja Mengikuti Prosesnya
segments.tr: ## How Workers Can Follow the Process

segments.src: 1. **Pantau sumber resmi.** Situs DPR (dpr.go.id) memuat jadwal rapat, naskah, dan risalah. Siaran rapat umumnya juga tersedia di kanal resmi DPR.
segments.tr: - **Monitor official sources.** The DPR website (dpr.go.id) contains meeting schedules, manuscripts, and minutes. Meeting broadcasts are generally also available on the DPR's official channels.

segments.src: 2. **Gunakan jalur partisipasi publik.** Pembentuk undang-undang berkewajiban membuka ruang partisipasi yang bermakna, yaitu hak didengar, hak dipertimbangkan, dan hak mendapat penjelasan. Anda dapat menyampaikan masukan tertulis melalui serikat, organisasi, atau kanal aspirasi resmi.
segments.tr: - **Use public participation channels.** Lawmakers are obligated to open meaningful participation spaces, namely the right to be heard, the right to be considered, and the right to get an explanation. You can submit written input through unions, organizations, or official aspiration channels.

segments.src: 3. **Bergabung atau berkonsultasi dengan serikat pekerja.** Serikat biasanya menyusun kajian pasal dan menyampaikannya dalam rapat dengar pendapat.
segments.tr: - **Join or consult with labor unions.** Unions typically compile article reviews and present them in hearings.

segments.src: 4. **Baca lebih dari satu sumber.** Bandingkan pemberitaan beberapa media dengan dokumen asli sebelum menyimpulkan.
segments.tr: - **Read more than one source.** Compare reports from several media outlets with the original documents before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: 5. **Siapkan diri setelah disahkan.** Perhatikan aturan turunan dan masa transisi, lalu periksa kembali perjanjian kerja, peraturan perusahaan, dan perjanjian kerja bersama Anda.
segments.tr: - **Prepare yourself after enactment.** Pay attention to derivative rules and transition periods, then re-examine your employment agreement, company regulations, and collective labor agreement.

segments.src: 6. **Ketahui jalur hukum.** Undang-undang yang telah disahkan dapat diuji ke Mahkamah Konstitusi oleh pihak yang memiliki kedudukan hukum.
segments.tr: - **Know the legal avenues.** Enacted laws can be challenged in the Constitutional Court by parties with legal standing.

segments.src: ## Hal yang Perlu Diingat
segments.tr: ## Things to Remember

segments.src: - Persetujuan membawa RUU ke paripurna bukan akhir proses, dan isi rancangan masih bisa disesuaikan sampai keputusan diambil.
segments.tr: - Approval to bring the bill to the plenary meeting is not the end of the process, and the contents of the draft can still be adjusted until a decision is made.

segments.src: - Perubahan baru berlaku setelah undang-undang diundangkan, sering kali dengan masa transisi dan aturan pelaksana.
segments.tr: - Changes only take effect after the law is enacted, often with transition periods and implementing regulations.

segments.src: - Perdebatan wajar terjadi karena kepentingan pekerja, pengusaha, dan pemerintah perlu diseimbangkan. Memahami isi pasal lebih berguna daripada bereaksi pada judul berita.
segments.tr: - Debate is natural because the interests of workers, employers, and the government need to be balanced. Understanding the content of the articles is more useful than reacting to news headlines.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Bagi pekerja, cara terbaik menyikapi RUU Ketenagakerjaan adalah memahami tahapannya, membaca teks resmi, dan menyalurkan masukan lewat jalur yang tersedia.
segments.tr: For workers, the best way to approach the Employment Bill is to understand its stages, read the official text, and channel input through available paths.

segments.src: Dengan begitu, Anda dapat menilai sendiri dampak aturan tersebut terhadap upah, pesangon, dan status kerja, serta siap menghadapi perubahan jika undang-undang ini resmi disahkan.
segments.tr: By doing so, you can assess for yourself the impact of the regulations on wages, severance pay, and work status, as well as be prepared to face changes if this law is officially enacted.

id-20261023-news-2.title: Haze and Forest Fires During the Long Dry Season: Weighing Dry Ice Trials in South Sumatra

segments.src: Setiap musim kemarau panjang, warga Sumatera Selatan akrab dengan langit yang berubah keruh.
segments.tr: During every long dry season, residents of South Sumatra are familiar with skies turning hazy.

segments.src: Kebakaran hutan dan lahan (karhutla), terutama di lahan gambut, menghasilkan asap yang menyebar melintasi batas kabupaten, provinsi, bahkan negara.
segments.tr: Forest and land fires (karhutla), especially on peatlands, produce smoke that spreads across district, provincial, and even national borders.

segments.src: Ketika asap menebal, pemerintah mencari cara cepat untuk menguranginya.
segments.tr: When the smoke thickens, the government looks for quick ways to reduce it.

segments.src: Salah satu opsi yang kini diprioritaskan adalah uji coba es kering (*dry ice*) untuk mengurai kabut asap.
segments.tr: One option now prioritized is testing dry ice (*dry ice*) to disperse the haze.

segments.src: Artikel ini mengulas cara kerja gagasan tersebut, apa yang realistis diharapkan darinya, dampak asap bagi kesehatan dan penerbangan, serta langkah pencegahan yang lebih mendasar.
segments.tr: This article reviews how the idea works, what is realistically expected of it, the impact of smoke on health and aviation, and more fundamental prevention steps.

segments.src: Informasi di sini bersifat umum dan tidak menggantikan rilis resmi instansi terkait.
segments.tr: Information here is general and does not replace official releases from related agencies.

segments.src: Untuk angka dan status terbaru, rujuklah BMKG, BNPB, serta pemerintah daerah.
segments.tr: For the latest figures and status, refer to BMKG, BNPB, and local governments.

segments.src: ## Mengapa kabut asap muncul berulang
segments.tr: ## Why haze appears repeatedly

segments.src: Karhutla di Sumatera Selatan umumnya berkaitan dengan kombinasi beberapa faktor:
segments.tr: Fires in South Sumatra are generally related to a combination of several factors:

segments.src: - **Musim kemarau panjang.** Curah hujan rendah membuat vegetasi dan tanah mengering. Fenomena iklim seperti El Niño atau Indian Ocean Dipole positif kerap memperpanjang kemarau.
segments.tr: - **Long dry season.** Low rainfall causes vegetation and soil to dry out. Climate phenomena like El Niño or the positive Indian Ocean Dipole often prolong the dry season.

segments.src: - **Lahan gambut yang mengering.** Gambut yang kehilangan air mudah terbakar dan bisa menyala di bawah permukaan. Api jenis ini sulit dipadamkan dan menghasilkan asap pekat dalam waktu lama.
segments.tr: - **Drying peatlands.** Peat that loses water easily burns and can ignite underground. This type of fire is difficult to extinguish and produces thick smoke for a long time.

segments.src: - **Pembukaan lahan dengan cara membakar.** Sebagian besar titik api berkaitan dengan aktivitas manusia, baik disengaja maupun karena kelalaian.
segments.tr: - **Land clearing by burning.** Most hotspots are related to human activities, whether intentional or due to negligence.

segments.src: - **Kondisi angin dan atmosfer.** Pola angin menentukan ke mana asap bergerak, dan lapisan udara yang stabil membuat asap terperangkap dekat permukaan.
segments.tr: - **Wind and atmospheric conditions.** Wind patterns determine where the smoke moves, and stable air layers trap the smoke near the surface.

segments.src: ## Apa itu uji coba es kering
segments.tr: ## What is a dry ice trial

segments.src: Es kering adalah karbon dioksida padat dengan suhu sangat rendah.
segments.tr: Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide with a very low temperature.

segments.src: Dalam konteks modifikasi cuaca, es kering lazimnya disebarkan dari pesawat ke awan tertentu.
segments.tr: In the context of weather modification, dry ice is typically spread from airplanes into specific clouds.

segments.src: Tujuannya mendinginkan awan dan memicu pembentukan kristal es sehingga proses hujan lebih mungkin terjadi.
segments.tr: The goal is to cool the clouds and trigger the formation of ice crystals so that rain is more likely to occur.

segments.src: Jika hujan turun, partikel asap dapat tersapu dan titik api lebih lembap.
segments.tr: If rain falls, smoke particles can be washed away and hotspots made more humid.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat bahwa pendekatan ini **bukan membuat hujan dari nol**.
segments.tr: It should be noted that this approach **is not making rain from scratch**.

segments.src: Modifikasi cuaca hanya dapat bekerja bila sudah ada awan yang cukup, dengan kandungan uap air dan kondisi yang sesuai.
segments.tr: Weather modification can only work if there are already sufficient clouds, with appropriate water vapor content and conditions.

segments.src: Pada kemarau yang sangat kering, awan potensial sering jarang sehingga ruang geraknya terbatas.
segments.tr: In a very dry drought, potential clouds are often scarce so room for maneuver is limited.

segments.src: Karena itu istilah "uji coba" penting.
segments.tr: Therefore, the term "trial" is important.

segments.src: Hasilnya perlu dievaluasi secara terbuka: apakah hujan benar-benar turun, di mana, seberapa lebat, dan apakah memengaruhi kualitas udara maupun kondisi lahan yang terbakar.
segments.tr: The results need to be openly evaluated: whether rain actually fell, where, how heavily, and whether it affected air quality or the condition of the burned land.

segments.src: ## Seberapa efektif secara realistis
segments.tr: ## How realistically effective is it

segments.src: Beberapa hal layak dipertimbangkan saat menilai efektivitasnya:
segments.tr: Several things are worth considering when assessing its effectiveness:

segments.src: 1. **Ketergantungan pada awan.** Tanpa awan yang memadai, hasilnya minim. Waktu dan lokasi penyemaian sangat menentukan.
segments.tr: 1. **Dependence on clouds.** Without adequate clouds, results are minimal. Timing and seeding location are crucial.

segments.src: 2. **Sifat hujan yang sementara.** Hujan buatan dapat meredam asap dan membasahi permukaan untuk sementara. Pada gambut yang terbakar dalam, api bawah tanah bisa muncul kembali bila tidak ada pembasahan jangka panjang.
segments.tr: 2. **Temporary nature of rain.** Artificial rain can temporarily suppress smoke and wet the surface. On deeply burned peat, underground fires can re-ignite if there is no long-term wetting.

segments.src: 3. **Sulit mengukur dampak.** Memisahkan hujan hasil intervensi dari hujan alami memerlukan data dan kajian yang cermat.
segments.tr: 3. **Difficult to measure impact.** Separating intervention-induced rain from natural rain requires careful data and study.

segments.src: 4. **Biaya dan logistik.** Operasi udara memerlukan pesawat, bahan, personel, dan koordinasi, sehingga perlu dibandingkan dengan biaya langkah lain.
segments.tr: 4. **Cost and logistics.** Aerial operations require aircraft, materials, personnel, and coordination, so they need to be compared with the costs of other measures.

segments.src: Dengan demikian, es kering paling tepat dipandang sebagai **alat pelengkap** dalam penanganan darurat, bukan solusi tunggal.
segments.tr: Thus, dry ice is best viewed as a **complementary tool** in emergency handling, not a single solution.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi kesehatan
segments.tr: ## Health impacts

segments.src: Asap karhutla mengandung partikel halus (PM2,5) dan gas berbahaya seperti karbon monoksida.
segments.tr: Fire smoke contains fine particles (PM2,5) and hazardous gases like carbon monoxide.

segments.src: Partikel halus dapat masuk jauh ke saluran pernapasan.
segments.tr: Fine particles can penetrate deep into the respiratory tract.

segments.src: Dampak yang umum dilaporkan antara lain:
segments.tr: Commonly reported impacts include:

segments.src: - iritasi mata, hidung, dan tenggorokan;
segments.tr: - irritation of the eyes, nose, and throat;

segments.src: - batuk, sesak napas, dan infeksi saluran pernapasan akut (ISPA);
segments.tr: - cough, shortness of breath, and acute respiratory infections (ARI);

segments.src: - memburuknya asma, penyakit paru obstruktif kronis, dan penyakit jantung;
segments.tr: - worsening of asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and heart disease;

segments.src: - risiko lebih besar bagi anak-anak, lansia, ibu hamil, dan orang dengan penyakit penyerta.
segments.tr: - greater risk for children, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with comorbidities.

segments.src: Langkah praktis bagi warga saat kualitas udara memburuk:
segments.tr: Practical steps for residents when air quality worsens:

segments.src: - pantau Indeks Standar Pencemar Udara (ISPU) dari sumber resmi;
segments.tr: - monitor the Air Pollutant Standard Index (ISPU) from official sources;

segments.src: - kurangi aktivitas di luar ruangan, terutama olahraga berat;
segments.tr: - reduce outdoor activities, especially strenuous exercise;

segments.src: - gunakan masker yang sesuai, misalnya N95 atau yang setara, dan pastikan terpasang rapat;
segments.tr: - use appropriate masks, such as N95 or equivalent, and ensure a tight fit;

segments.src: - tutup jendela dan, bila memungkinkan, gunakan pembersih udara di ruang tertutup;
segments.tr: - close windows and, if possible, use air purifiers in enclosed spaces;

segments.src: - segera cari layanan kesehatan bila muncul sesak napas atau gejala yang memburuk.
segments.tr: - seek medical attention immediately if shortness of breath or worsening symptoms appear.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi penerbangan dan mobilitas
segments.tr: ## Impacts on aviation and mobility

segments.src: Asap menurunkan jarak pandang.
segments.tr: Smoke reduces visibility.

segments.src: Bandara dapat menunda atau mengalihkan penerbangan ketika visibilitas berada di bawah batas keselamatan.
segments.tr: Airports may delay or divert flights when visibility falls below safety limits.

segments.src: Dampaknya merembet ke jadwal penumpang, logistik, dan kegiatan ekonomi daerah.
segments.tr: The impact ripples into passenger schedules, logistics, and regional economic activities.

segments.src: Transportasi darat dan sungai juga terganggu, sementara sekolah kerap harus mengubah jam belajar atau beralih ke pembelajaran dari rumah.
segments.tr: Land and river transportation are also disrupted, while schools often have to change study hours or switch to learning from home.

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha kecil, hari-hari berasap berarti pendapatan yang tertekan.
segments.tr: For small business owners, smoky days mean depressed income.

segments.src: ## Pencegahan yang lebih mendasar
segments.tr: ## More fundamental prevention

segments.src: Penanganan saat asap sudah tebal selalu lebih mahal dan lebih sulit daripada pencegahan.
segments.tr: Handling matters when smoke is thick is always more expensive and difficult than prevention.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah yang secara luas dinilai penting:
segments.tr: Several steps widely considered important:

segments.src: - **Pembasahan dan restorasi gambut.** Menjaga muka air gambut, misalnya lewat sekat kanal dan pembasahan, mengurangi risiko terbakar.
segments.tr: - **Peat wetting and restoration.** Maintaining the peat water table, for example through canal blocking and wetting, reduces the risk of burning.

segments.src: - **Pencegahan dini berbasis data.** Pemantauan titik panas, prakiraan cuaca, dan sistem peringatan dini membantu petugas bergerak sebelum api meluas.
segments.tr: - **Data-driven early prevention.** Hotspot monitoring, weather forecasts, and early warning systems help officers move before fires spread.

segments.src: - **Penegakan hukum yang konsisten.** Larangan membuka lahan dengan membakar perlu dibarengi pengawasan dan sanksi yang adil.
segments.tr: - **Consistent law enforcement.** The ban on land clearing by burning needs to be accompanied by supervision and fair sanctions.

segments.src: - **Pendampingan petani.** Alternatif pembukaan lahan tanpa bakar, termasuk bantuan alat dan pendanaan, membuat petani kecil tidak terdesak.
segments.tr: - **Farmer assistance.** Alternatives to burning land clearing, including tool assistance and funding, keep small farmers from being cornered.

segments.src: - **Patroli dan pemadam desa.** Masyarakat Peduli Api dan regu tingkat desa terbukti penting karena berada paling dekat dengan lokasi kejadian.
segments.tr: - **Patrols and village firefighters.** The Fire Concerned Community and village-level teams proved important because they are closest to the incident location.

segments.src: - **Tata kelola konsesi.** Perusahaan pemegang izin perlu memiliki sarana pencegahan dan pemadaman, serta diawasi pelaksanaannya.
segments.tr: - **Concession governance.** Permit-holding companies need to have prevention and firefighting facilities, and their implementation supervised.

segments.src: - **Transparansi evaluasi.** Hasil uji coba dan penanganan karhutla sebaiknya dipublikasikan agar publik dapat menilai apa yang berhasil.
segments.tr: - **Evaluation transparency.** Trial results and fire handling should be published so the public can assess what works.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Uji coba es kering di Sumatera Selatan patut dicermati sebagai salah satu upaya mengurangi kabut asap dalam situasi darurat.
segments.tr: Dry ice trials in South Sumatra are worth noting as an effort to reduce haze in emergency situations.

segments.src: Namun efektivitasnya bergantung pada kondisi awan dan cuaca, dan dampaknya cenderung sementara.
segments.tr: However, their effectiveness depends on cloud and weather conditions, and impacts tend to be temporary.

segments.src: Penyelesaian jangka panjang tetap terletak pada pencegahan: menjaga gambut tetap basah, mencegah pembakaran lahan, memperkuat kesiapsiagaan di tingkat desa, dan menegakkan aturan secara konsisten.
segments.tr: Long-term resolution remains in prevention: keeping peat wet, preventing land burning, strengthening village-level preparedness, and enforcing rules consistently.

segments.src: Sambil menunggu hasil evaluasi, warga disarankan tetap memantau informasi resmi dan menjaga kesehatan masing-masing.
segments.tr: While waiting for evaluation results, residents are advised to keep monitoring official information and take care of their health.
